sql: SELECT "compliancecase"."compreg" AS k, (CAST("compliancecase"."modelconf" AS REAL) / "compliancecase"."risksc") AS m1 FROM "compliancecase" WHERE (CAST("compliancecase"."modelconf" AS REAL) / "compliancecase"."risksc") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: compliancecase.model confidence relative to compliance risk score
why: model confidence / compliance risk score: a ratio of two quantities in points
rank compliancecase rows by model confidence relative to compliance risk score

sql: SELECT "transactionrecord"."transreg" AS k, (CAST("transactionrecord"."cancelpct" AS REAL) / "transactionrecord"."offmkt") AS m1 FROM "transactionrecord" WHERE (CAST("transactionrecord"."cancelpct" AS REAL) / "transactionrecord"."offmkt") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: transactionrecord.order cancellation share relative to off-exchange trade share
why: order cancellation share / off-exchange trade share: a ratio of two quantities in fraction
rank transactionrecord rows by order cancellation share relative to off-exchange trade share

sql: SELECT "sentimentandfundamentals"."sentreg" AS k, (CAST("sentimentandfundamentals"."instownpct" AS REAL) / "sentimentandfundamentals"."impvolrank") AS m1 FROM "sentimentandfundamentals" WHERE (CAST("sentimentandfundamentals"."instownpct" AS REAL) / "sentimentandfundamentals"."impvolrank") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: sentimentandfundamentals.institutional ownership relative to implied volatility rank
why: institutional ownership / implied volatility rank: a ratio of two quantities in percent
rank sentimentandfundamentals rows by institutional ownership relative to implied volatility rank

sql: SELECT "sentimentandfundamentals"."sentreg" AS k, ("sentimentandfundamentals"."impvolrank" - "sentimentandfundamentals"."instownpct") AS m1 FROM "sentimentandfundamentals" WHERE ("sentimentandfundamentals"."impvolrank" - "sentimentandfundamentals"."instownpct") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: sentimentandfundamentals.implied volatility rank minus institutional ownership
why: implied volatility rank - institutional ownership: both in percent and of the same kind (stocks) on the same sentiment/fundamentals snapshot
rank sentimentandfundamentals rows by implied volatility rank minus institutional ownership
